thread:
Ana K: Quick pulse from the 6mo incident rollup. I distilled 3 repeating failure themes + 2 low-effort remediations each. Posting owners so we can convert to tickets.

Ben H: Nice. Can you drop the short list here?

Ana K: Sure 1) cold KV cache spikes -> fix: lightweight warming job + TTL audit. 2) transient scaling stalls on sudden bursts -> fix: cooldown + tiny reserved burst pool. 3) deploy config skew (missing secrets / feature flags) -> fix: env diff check + staged validation. Also an ops nit: routing fallback sometimes picks stale variant -> fix: explicit decommission flow.

Dina R: I can take #1 (warming) and the runbook. ETA 9 business days.

Ben H: I'll pick #2 (scaling) and the routing decommission flow. Need infra budget check for burst pool. ETA 7 business days for spike + dashboard.

Ana K: Proposed tickets: INC-2300-warm (owner: Dina R, due: 2026-05-05), INC-2301-scale (owner: Ben H, due: 2026-05-12), INC-2302-env-gate (owner: Ana K, due: 2026-05-03).

ops-bot: Please tag the new remediation tickets with upstream incident IDs for traceability.

Dina R: ACK INC-2300. I'll include a smoke check that runs a small inference batch post-warm. Example: `curl -X POST /internal/warm -d '{"keys":30}'` then run sample infer.

Ben H: ACK INC-2301. I'll add autoscale_miss_rate and burst_pool_util metrics to the dashboard. Will also propose a default fail-open policy while testing.

Ana K: I'll open INC-2302 PR for env-diff gate and include a staged validator that runs in canary. Small unit tests included.

incident-bot: Created tickets: INC-2300, INC-2301, INC-2302.

Ana K: Plan: two-week follow-up thread and status board update. If you hit blockers, add notes to the ticket and ping me. Small mitigations expected to reduce repeat incidents by ~30% per analysis. Thanks :thumbsup:
